items.briefing:
Concerns are growing in Australia about smart glasses capable of covert filming, with calls for a ban amid privacy risks for individuals in public spaces — relevant for staff to be aware of in workplace and public settings. Meanwhile, South Australia has launched a Royal Commission into artificial intelligence, signalling that AI use will face increasing scrutiny and regulation across the country.

As Australian AI cloud spending is forecast to reach AUD $1.5 billion, organisations should ensure any AI tools they adopt are properly vetted and data is handled responsibly. **Practical tip:** Before using any AI-powered tool for work, check with your manager or IT team that it's approved for handling organisational or student data.

featured.title: South Australia launches Royal Commission into artificial intelligence
featured.quote: South Australia's Royal Commission into AI signals government-level scrutiny of AI governance and regulation.
